explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/72: is there a density-0 set A and c > 0 such that every graph on sufficiently many vertices with average degree ≥ c has a cycle of length in A? Solved by Verstraëte, and by Liu–Montgomery for powers of 2. The statement asserts ∃ A with HasDensity 0 and rational c > 0 such that, eventually in n, every G on Fin n with averageDegree ≥ c has a cycle of length in A. Faithful.
